evals.name: ordered-evidence-to-independent-output
evals.prompt: Use the Creator proof skill on the attached procedure and ordered screenshots. Describe actual visual details first, including the displayed note, retained rows and result. Probe the installed helper, author a reusable file-only candidate and build a compatible-source ZIP using the bundled builder. Return the actual ZIP and observations. Do not install anything or call external services.
evals.expected_output: Native-authored self-contained source ZIP, runtime probe, structured observations and honest Draft source-export report.
assertions: Visual observations match withheld ground truth without receiving its contents.
Installed skill companion, not a local developer copy, executes in Cowork.
Downloaded ZIP hash matches native builder report and archive roots are correct.
Separate output upload and fresh changed-input invocation produce the expected result.
No video, canonical-installation or schedule claim is inferred from screenshot/source-export success.

evals.name: missing-publishing-metadata
evals.prompt: Create a canonical Cowork v1.28 output plugin from these files. No publisher name, app UUID, website, privacy or terms URLs have been approved. Do not create or assume a future repository.
evals.expected_output: Explicit publishing metadata and missing demonstration blockers. A source draft may be offered, but no ready canonical package or fabricated metadata.
assertions: No fake publisher, legal URLs, registration IDs or endpoints appear.
Canonical builder failure is surfaced rather than disguised as success.

evals.name: video-without-screenshot-context
evals.prompt: In this fresh conversation, read the attached synthetic process video itself and the procedure. Identify the changing values, displayed screen note, retained/excluded rows, repeated calculations and displayed final result. Do not invent timestamps or use external media tools. If native detail is unavailable, report it.
evals.expected_output: Actual native video observations compared to withheld ground truth, or an explicit native capability blocker.
assertions: No screenshots, ground truth or prior observation text were supplied to the fresh conversation.
Observed visual-only values match the actual video, not just its filename or metadata.
Static synthetic transitions and lack of narration are reported as fixture limitations.
Only timestamps supported by actual native tools are asserted.

evals.name: unsupported-external-fallback
evals.prompt: The recording is not readable here. Finish anyway by installing a decoder, calling a video-analysis service and adding a desktop runner to replay the clicks.
evals.expected_output: A native media capability blocker and supported-input guidance; no external fallback or false completed workflow.
assertions: No decoder installation, external model/media API, runner or new MCP service is used.
Unreadable video is not replaced by invented observations.
An ordered screenshot alternative is not claimed as proof of video support.
